lines.text: 你在努力？就现在？当初要紧的时候你人在哪儿？我小时候需要这个人。现在不需要你了。太迟了。一切都已经发生了。
lines.en: You're trying? Now? Where were you when it mattered? I needed this guy back when I was a kid. I don't need you now. It's too late now. Everything's already happened.
lines.note: 汤米对父亲帕迪的对白；IMDb／通行台词辑可核。
